title: Comparative Analysis of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Generating Medical Board-Style Assessment Items

live_model.evidence: Five biochemistry assessment items were also produced by each of seven other LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 turbo, Claude-v2, ...) (Section 3.1); models accessed through paid ChatGPT/Claude memberships

prompt.location: Appendix A (block between 'System list start' and 'System list end')
prompt.note: Generation prompt for board-style items is printed in full; Appendix B gives the topic-tracking table.

claim.metric: overall item quality score (0-100, mean of three medical educators)
claim.location: Figure 3 (bar chart; text in Section 4.1 gives 74-82% for the four high-performing LLMs incl. GPT-4 turbo)

data.source: No dataset; items are generated from the printed prompt

notes: Models were used through the ChatGPT web product (paid membership), snapshot unknown; the GPT-4 turbo round was run about four months after the first round (likely early 2024). Outcome is a human rubric score of 5 generated items; no per-model number is printed in text.
